verses.en: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.pt: Os que confiam no SENHOR são como o monte de Sião, que não se abala, e permanece para sempre.
verses.en_web: Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> Those whose hope is in the Lord are like the mountain of Zion, which may not be moved, but keeps its place for ever.

verses.en: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.pt: Assim como montanhas estão ao redor de Jerusalém, assim também o SENHOR está ao redor de seu povo, desde agora para sempre.
verses.en_web: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.
verses.en_bbe: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people, from this time and for ever.

verses.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.pt: Porque o cetro da maldade não repousará sobre a sorte dos justos, para que os justos não estendam suas mãos à perversidade.
verses.en_web: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.
verses.en_bbe: For the rod of sinners will not be resting on the heritage of the upright; so that the upright may not put out their hands to evil.

verses.en: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.pt: SENHOR, trata bem aos bons, e aos corretos em seus corações.
verses.en_web: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.en_bbe: Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in heart.

verses.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.pt: Mas aos que se dirigem a seus caminhos tortuosos, o SENHOR os mandará embora junto com os que praticam perversidade. Paz seja sobre Israel. Cântico dos degraus:
verses.en_web: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But as for such as are turned out of the straight way, the Lord will take them away with the workers of evil. Let peace be on Israel.
